meta.title: fix(api): Update mocha configuration to use SWC instead of ts-node
meta.body_summary: Switch API test compilation from ts-node to SWC to improve test execution speed, break circular dependencies, and add S3 mocking for test reliability.

perf_labels.notes: Devin's initial SWC migration faced circular dependency and ES module issues; maintainer scopsy made extensive follow-up fixes and merged after reporting ~8s to 4-5s test speedup.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2214 changed lines across 32 files, this is a medium-to-large refactor, though much of the churn is in lockfile updates (1723 lines in pnpm-lock.yaml). The core SWC migration and circular dependency fixes are concentrated in fewer files. This size is consistent with a toolchain migration performance PR that merged after extensive human adjustments.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer scopsy requested alignment of the SWC register script with .swcrc and removal of the lazy flag.
review_details.performance_claim: SWC compilation should improve test execution speed.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Devin handled initial SWC setup but struggled with circular dependencies and ES module compat; extensive human intervention required to finalize SWC config and mock S3. This reveals boundary in complex build tool migration in a NestJS monorepo.

detection_detail.code_reading: scopsy reviewed swc-register.js and requested alignment with .swcrc and removal of lazy flag.
detection_detail.manual_testing: scopsy manually timed test execution and reported speedup from ~8s to 4-5s.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes test run instructions but no automated benchmark; maintainer reported manual timing result.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After initial submission, scopsy made numerous commits to fix SWC config, circular deps, S3 mocking, and test failures, ultimately merging the PR.

core_change_summary.description: Changed API test compilation from ts-node to SWC by creating swc-register.js with pirates hook, updating .mocharc.json, package.json, and .swcrc. Added interface-based dependency injection to break circular dependency between PromoteNotificationTemplateChange and PromoteChangeToEnvironment. Mocked S3 storage for tests to avoid ECONNREFUSED. Removed the lazy flag from SWC config per review feedback.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Lock file and CI workflow modifications are supportive; majority of line changes are in pnpm-lock.yaml.
change_trajectory: Initial Devin commits added SWC config and mocha updates.
Subsequent Devin commits fixed circular dependency with new interface, added custom swc-register for .source files, and mocked S3.
Maintainer scopsy then made many fix commits to align configs, remove lazy, add pirates dependency, handle imports, fix test timeouts, and restore accidental deletions.
Merged after ~42 hours following manual timing validation.
